packages.label_en: Eretz Yisrael and the Burial of Tzaddikim
packages.reason: The torah equates the burial place of true tzaddikim with Eretz Yisrael itself — their grave is holy with the actual holiness of the Land. This is a bechina identification: מקום גניזתם הוא קדוש בקדושת ארץ ישראל ממש. Additionally, Eretz Yisrael is identified as a tikkun for pgam habrit. All concepts cluster around the holiness of Eretz Yisrael as manifested in the tzaddik's resting place.
merge_notes: All three concepts form a single connected component via bechina-type identifications in the source text: the tzaddik's burial place IS Eretz Yisrael, and Eretz Yisrael IS tikkun for pgam habrit. No merging of separate components was needed — these naturally form one cluster.
